tools.name: convert_local_video
tools.description: Use when the user gives you a video FILE on their computer (a screen recording .mov/.mp4/.webm, a Loom or QuickTime download) that you cannot watch. This server cannot read local files, so this tool returns the exact one-line curl command that uploads the file and prints the change list as Markdown;
